messages.subject: RmySql and Shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to use shiny to create google charts like the one describe here: http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/google-charts.html. My problem is that i'm using RmySQL to retrieve my data from my server and fill the chart with those data. It works fine on R but when i try to plug my chart into a webpage (by using shinyapps.io) it doesn't work. I think that's because the app can not connect to my server.
What do you think ? Does anyone has any solution to my problem ?
Thanks.

messages.subject: Re: RmySql and Shinyapps.io
parts:
Anthony,

As I said on the other thread you posted: what needs to happen here is that the shinyapps.io servers need to be able to connect to YOUR mysql servers. This is not something that shinyapps.io controls, but rather is something your local network must be setup to allow. Typically this done with firewall rules or NATs, but that's entirely dependent on your local network. If you are on a corporate or campus network, you should reach out to your network administrator. 

-Andy
